name: Fai
source:
Running a shop in addition to being the royal blacksmith, Far is one of the youngest blacksmiths to achieve the rank of "Master".

He's a man of few words and fewer expressions. If you want to stay in his good graces, don't call him a "hot-head."

[From [url=https://chouette.itch.io/heroine-for-hire]itch.io[/url]]
